name: Kamala Copperheart
source:
Curious and sociable at heart, Kamala volunteered to be an envoy for her homeland. Hailing from the trade kingdom of Alkos, Kamala seeks an alliance with Caerulia in an effort to defend her home from invaders.

Likes: Spices, shopping, travel, festivals

Dislikes: Swimming, dogs
